title: AI Security
summary: Protect LLM, RAG and agent systems from model-specific attacks, unsafe actions, data leaks and compliance risk.
outcome: Threat-model, defend and red-team LLM, RAG and agent systems so they stay safe when the model makes a bad decision.

project.title: Red-Team & Secure an Agentic RAG App
deliverables: Attack an existing app with direct and indirect prompt injection
Attack it with malicious retrieved documents
Attempt tool misuse and unauthorized actions
Add least-privilege tools and permission checks
Add guardrails plus PII and secrets protection
Add security regression tests for every vulnerability found

modules.title: AI threat model

topics.d: Risk grows when models read untrusted content, access data, call tools and act.
Where trust changes across prompts, retrieval, tools, memory and outputs.
Validate outputs and actions before trusting them.

modules.outcome: Threat-model an LLM app before adding defenses.

modules.title: Prompt injection & data exfiltration

topics.d: From the user vs hidden in docs, pages, emails, chunks or tool outputs.
Override instructions, manipulate tools, expose context or redirect goals.

topics.t: Untrusted input + tools + an exit path
topics.d: The risky combination that enables exfiltration.
Separation, least privilege, authz checks, restricted tools, confirmation and output validation.
Prompt wording is not a reliable security boundary.

modules.outcome: Build apps that stay safe even when malicious instructions reach the model.

modules.title: Jailbreaks, guardrails & moderation

topics.d: How they differ and common jailbreak patterns.
Checks, moderation, validation and policy enforcement.

topics.t: Why one layer is not enough
topics.d: Limits of model-based guardrails; defense in depth.
Adversarial and obfuscated inputs, not just normal ones.

modules.outcome: Reduce unsafe behavior without relying on one defensive prompt.

modules.title: Agent & tool security

topics.d: Only the tools and permissions the task needs.
Reads vs sending, changing, deleting, buying or running code.

topics.t: Validating tool use outside the LLM
topics.d: Check tool choice, args, permissions and outputs independently.
Human sign-off for sensitive operations.
Caps that prevent runaway execution.
Isolate generated code; treat generated SQL, commands and URLs as untrusted.

modules.outcome: Give agents autonomy without unrestricted control over real systems.

modules.title: RAG & knowledge security

topics.t: Retrieved documents are data, not instructions
topics.d: Retrieved content is untrusted.
Malicious instructions planted in indexed documents.
Users retrieve only what they may see.
No data crossing users or tenants via vectors or memory.
Keep source information attached to content.

modules.outcome: Secure the knowledge layer beneath a RAG app.

modules.title: Data privacy, PII & secrets

topics.d: PII, credentials, financial data, conversations and confidential business data.
Mask or remove sensitive data before it reaches models.

topics.t: Keeping PII out of logs & traces
topics.d: No unnecessary sensitive data in logs, traces, memory, vectors or eval sets.
Retention, deletion, location, access and provider risk.
Private endpoints, no public egress and zero-retention terms.
Keep secrets away from the model unless strictly necessary.

modules.outcome: Minimize sensitive information exposed across an AI system.

modules.title: Red teaming AI systems

topics.d: Injection, jailbreaks, malicious docs, tool misuse and data extraction.
Plant malicious content in retrievable docs.
Make agents exceed permissions, misuse tools or loop.
Every finding becomes a permanent test.
Track attack success, leakage and unsafe-action rates.

modules.outcome: Test defenses adversarially instead of assuming they work.

modules.title: Responsible AI & governance

topics.d: Hallucination, fairness, transparency, accountability and oversight.
Intended use, limitations, risks, evaluations and controls.

topics.t: The EU AI Act & India's DPDP
topics.d: Practical implications of both frameworks.
Versions, logs, approvals and evaluation records.

modules.outcome: Recognize when an AI app creates governance or compliance obligations.

modules.title: Capstone: Red-Team & Secure an Agentic RAG App

topics.t: Attack an app you already built
topics.d: Injection, malicious docs, jailbreaks, extraction, tool misuse and unauthorized actions.
Least privilege, permission checks, guardrails, PII protection, approvals, sandboxing and regression tests.

modules.outcome: An agentic RAG app that stays safe under malicious input.
